items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Nothing, but old-time friendship. We knew each other for quite some time, man.

ctx.x: How did that come about? Was it a feature film?
Yeah, I was over there, American entertainer over there with the Nicholas Brothers, that's why they used me, I guess and I was known, too, so that makes it a little different also.
